Retro Gameboy camera filter for your mobile Access stunning photo and video effects from the 90s! Unleash your creativity with this great retro Gameboy filter effect app and share it with your network.
You can select colors, the classic green or black and white.

Gameboy camera is the popular retro Gameboy effect to transform your pictures and videos. And it's free!

Show off and share your amazing photos, camera videos on Instagram with #gameboycamera_lab and your super pic could appear!

Keep taking photos with the pixel camera, pixel filter and 8-bit effect filters.

PHOTOS AND FILTERS
Use different 90s gameboy exposures using camera layers with adjustable white, green and black lights to create and transform memes and photos for geeks.

VIDEO EDITOR
Some of our best camero photo features are now video maker enabled. Bring your unique story and background to life by adding fun Gameboy filters to transform your art into white and green colors. Be a super geeky editor from the 90s and express yourself live with this white and green editor.
